descriptionByLocale.it:
Specialista del Supporto Tecnico al 100% - Ingegneria Meccanica e Impiantistica BSA - Bobst Mex SA

Candidati ora

Consideri i problemi tecnici non come un ostacolo, ma come una sfida? ⚡ Con il vostro know-how garantite che le nostre macchine funzionino in modo affidabile in tutto il mondo e contribuite direttamente al successo dei nostri clienti. 🚀

Il packaging fornisce un contributo importante alla nostra società. Proteggono i prodotti durante il trasporto, ne consentono la conservazione, ne prolungano la durata e forniscono preziose informazioni sul contenuto. Bobst è uno dei fornitori leader a livello mondiale di attrezzature e servizi di qualità per i produttori di imballaggi ed etichette. Supportiamo i nostri clienti in più di 50 paesi, disponiamo di 14 stabilimenti produttivi e diamo lavoro a oltre 6.400 persone in tutto il mondo. Nella nostra sede di Grenchen (Svizzera) sviluppiamo e produciamo sistemi per la produzione di cartone ondulato laminato e ne garantiamo il funzionamento affidabile per i nostri clienti in tutto il mondo.

LA TUA MISSIONE

- Fornire supporto per la risoluzione dei problemi nel settore della tecnologia elettrica e di processo per clienti e dipendenti interni
- Coordinare le operazioni di servizio dalla pianificazione ai briefing al debriefing
- Garantire il trasferimento di conoscenze tra tecnici dell'assistenza, sviluppo e produzione
- Ricevere feedback dal campo e contribuire attivamente al miglioramento del prodotto e della qualità
- Supportare clienti e filiali direttamente in loco se necessario (attività di trasferta fino a circa il 40%)

Requisiti

- Hai completato la formazione come ingegnere dell'automazione, ingegnere elettronico, ingegnere meccatronico, ingegnere elettronico industriale o simili
- Costituiscono titolo preferenziale l'esperienza nel settore dell'ingegneria meccanica o impiantistica nonché la conoscenza dei PLC Siemens
- Buona conoscenza delle tecnologie di regolazione e controllo
descriptionByLocale.en:
Technical Support Specialist 100% - Mechanical & Plant Engineering BSA - Bobst Mex SA

Apply now

Do you see technical problems not as an obstacle, but as a challenge? ⚡ With your know-how, you ensure that our machines run reliably worldwide - and contribute directly to the success of our customers. 🚀

Packaging makes an important contribution to our society. They protect products during transport, enable them to be stored, extend their shelf life and provide valuable information about the contents. Bobst is one of the world's leading suppliers of quality equipment and services to packaging and label manufacturers. We support our customers in more than 50 countries, have 14 production facilities and employ over 6,400 people around the world. At our Grenchen site (Switzerland), we develop and produce systems for producing laminated corrugated cardboard - and ensure that these run reliably for our customers worldwide.

YOUR MISSION

- Provide troubleshooting support in the area of electrical and process technology for customers and internal employees
- Coordinate service operations from planning to briefings to debriefing
- Ensure knowledge transfer between service technicians, development and production
- Receive feedback from the field and actively contribute to product and quality improvements
- Support customers and branches directly on site if necessary (travel activity up to approx. 40%)

Requirements

- You have completed training as an automation engineer, electronics engineer, mechatronics engineer, industrial electronics engineer or similar
- Experience in mechanical or plant engineering as well as knowledge of Siemens PLC are a big advantage
- Good knowledge of regulation and control technology

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Spécialiste du support technique 100% - Ingénierie mécanique et industrielle BSA - Bobst Mex SA

Postulez maintenant

Considérez-vous les problèmes techniques non pas comme un obstacle, mais comme un défi ? ⚡ Grâce à votre savoir-faire, vous veillez à ce que nos machines fonctionnent de manière fiable dans le monde entier - et contribuez directement au succès de nos clients. 🚀

L'emballage apporte une contribution importante à notre société. Ils protègent les produits pendant le transport, permettent leur stockage, prolongent leur durée de conservation et fournissent des informations précieuses sur leur contenu. Bobst est l'un des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux d'équipements et de services de qualité destinés aux fabricants d'emballages et d'étiquettes. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans plus de 50 pays, disposons de 14 sites de production et employons plus de 6 400 personnes dans le monde. Sur notre site de Granges (Suisse), nous développons et produisons des installations pour la production de carton ondulé laminé - et veillons à ce qu'elles fonctionnent de manière fiable pour nos clients du monde entier.

VOTRE MISSION

- Fournir une assistance au dépannage dans le domaine de la technologie électrique et des processus pour les clients et les employés internes
- Coordonner les opérations de service de la planification aux briefings en passant par le débriefing
- Assurer le transfert de connaissances entre les techniciens de service, de développement et de production
- Recevoir les retours du terrain et contribuer activement aux améliorations produits et qualité
- Accompagner les clients et les agences directement sur place si nécessaire (activité de déplacement jusqu'à environ 40%)

Exigences

- Vous avez suivi une formation d'ingénieur en automation, d'ingénieur en électronique, d'ingénieur en mécatronique, d'ingénieur en électronique industrielle ou assimilé
- Une expérience en ingénierie mécanique ou d'installation ainsi qu'une connaissance de Siemens PLC sont un gros avantage
- Bonne connaissance des technologies de régulation et de contrôle

jobs.description:
Field Service & Commissioning Engineer – Automation & Motion Control BSA - Bobst Mex SA Apply now Join Our Web-Fed Solutions Team Within the Services & Performance Business Unit, we offer you the opportunity to join our Web-Fed Solutions External Field Service Pool as a Field Service & Commissioning Engineer – Automation & Motion Control. This is a full-time permanent position (100%) based at our Mex (VD) site, which serves as our corporate headquarters and production center. This role is intended for a professional who is passionate about complex industrial environments and capable of working autonomously on highly sophisticated automated production lines. You will be required to travel internationally for 50% to 60% of your working time, often on assignments lasting several consecutive weeks. YOUR MISSION Commission automated production lines in Switzerland and internationally.

Perform retrofit, modernization, and upgrade projects on existing installations.

Independently plan and organize on-site commissioning activities.

Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues related to automation, motion control, electrical systems, and industrial IT.

Program, modify, and optimize automation systems using Siemens TIA Portal and Siemens S7.

Commission and configure drive systems and synchronized motion axes.

Perform troubleshooting interventions both on customer sites and remotely.

Coordinate technical activities with customer teams.

Planifier et organiser indépendamment les activités de mise en service sur place.

Diagnostiquer et résoudre des problèmes techniques complexes liés à l'automatisation, au contrôle des mouvements, aux systèmes électriques et aux TI industrielles.

Programmer, modifier et optimiser les systèmes d'automatisation en utilisant Siemens TIA Portal et Siemens S7.

Commande et configuration des systèmes d'entraînement et des axes de mouvement synchronisés.

Effectuer des interventions de dépannage à la fois sur les sites clients et à distance.

Coordonner les activités techniques avec les équipes clientes.
